name: Apprentice's Duties
summary: In Menethil Harbor, James Halloran needs giant crocolisk hides for his trade. His apprentice has been mauled in the marshes, so Halloran asks travelers to take up the dangerous hunt.

sections.title: A Harsh Apprenticeship
sections.body: James Halloran sent his young apprentice into the Wetlands marshes to skin giant crocolisks. When the boy failed to return, Halloran went looking and found him badly mauled. Menethil Harbor's tradesmen rely on materials from the surrounding country, though the bogs make such work dangerous.

sections.title: Skins and Retribution
sections.body: The town midwife believes Halloran's apprentice will live, though the attack cost him a leg. Halloran needs hides for his trade, and he wants vengeance on the beasts that tore into the boy he loves like a son. He asks you to go north along the coast, past the murloc hovels, and hunt the giant crocolisks.

faq.answer: James Halloran is a leatherworker and tanner in Menethil Harbor. Hides from Wetlands wildlife keep his craft supplied.
Halloran sent his apprentice into the marsh to gather giant crocolisk hides. The beasts mauled the boy and took his leg, but the town midwife expects him to survive.

faq.q: Where are the giant crocolisks located?
faq.answer: Giant crocolisks prowl the Wetlands marshes and northern coast, beyond the coastal murloc settlements north of Menethil Harbor.

faq.q: What prerequisite quest leads to this task?
faq.answer: Halloran first asked travelers to hunt smaller crocolisks in 'Young Crocolisk Skins.' Now he asks them to hunt the giant variety that wounded his apprentice.

faq.q: Why does Halloran still want the skins after the tragedy?
faq.answer: Halloran needs hides to supply his trade, and he is angry at the beasts that maimed the boy he loves like a son. He welcomes a traveler willing to hunt them.

faq.q: Does Halloran offer you an apprenticeship?
faq.answer: After seeing your work, Halloran briefly jokes about taking you on as his new apprentice, then dismisses the idea. You are far too old, he says, and clearly bound for a different destiny.

angles.text: Menethil Harbor links Khaz Modan with the rest of the Alliance. The port depends on the safety and self-sufficiency of its local craftsmen.
Giant crocolisks are formidable marsh predators. Tracking them tests your skill at finding your way through murky waters and aggressive wildlife.
